environment: Managed preview through the cloud Chrome browser

download.noticeChange: Source-only wording correction after the failed delivery check; completion is no longer asserted.

observations: The shared preview service temporarily served a separate project during the first reload. Restoring Moonweave and reloading recovered the exact edited graph.
The graph export triggered a browser download event, but the browser reported that the download failed. No downloaded file was available for validation.
Browser policy blocked access to its internal downloads page. No alternate route or policy workaround was attempted.
Returned console errors concerned the temporary separate project and browser-extension metadata. No additional Moonweave application error appeared in those returned entries.
